summary: Patriot National Bancorp filed a Form 8-K on September 23, 2026, announcing a registered direct offering under an effective Form S-3 shelf. The Company agreed to sell 4,782,608 voting common shares at $1.15 per share and 956,522 five-year warrants to purchase non-voting common stock, one warrant per five shares, exercisable no earlier than six months after closing at $1.25 per warrant share. Gross proceeds are approximately $5.5 million, with $350,000 estimated expenses. Proceeds will capitalize Patriot Bank NA and fund general corporate purposes. No placement agent or underwriter participated.
